headline: Arsenal's Mikel Arteta fumes at Sunderland penalty decision: 'Unacceptable'
description: Mikel Arteta railed against the officials' decision to award Sunderland a penalty against Arsenal despite his side going on to win the match 2-0.

headline: Man City's Elliot Anderson: My first thought when getting ball is finding Erling Haaland
description: Elliot Anderson has quickly learned what his one of his main jobs at Manchester City is -- to give the ball to Erling Haaland.

headline: Premier League VAR review: Was Sunderland's penalty legit vs. Arsenal?
description: VAR often causes Premier League controversy, but how are decisions made and are they correct? Our resident ref, Andy Davies, explains all.

headline: Arsenal ratings: Guimaraes 8/10, Raya 9/10 in win at Sunderland
description: Bruno Guimaraes and David Raya were instrumental as Arsenal fought off Sunderland's aggressive effort to pick up a big win in Saturday's late Premier League game.

headline: Bruno Guimarães scores stunner as Arsenal overcome Sunderland
description: Bruno Guimarães and Bukayo Saka helped maintain Arsenal's perfect start in the Premier League with a 2-0 win over Sunderland.
